editorial:
If you loved the first movie, you will have a blast with this bigger, louder sequel. Larry Daley is back as the night watchman, but this time his living exhibit friends have been shipped off to the massive Smithsonian archives. Larry rushes to Washington to rescue them, and along the way he meets new historical characters like Amelia Earhart, Abe Lincoln, and Ivan the Terrible. The story is simple and silly, but it moves fast and keeps you smiling the whole time.

The cast is the real highlight here. Ben Stiller is funny as always, and Amy Adams brings tons of charm as Amelia Earhart. Hank Azaria steals scenes as the villain Kahmunrah. The action is big and silly, with giant octopuses and flying planes. On the downside, the plot is pretty thin and some jokes fall flat. Still, it is a great pick for a family movie night. You can stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray for the best picture.
endingExplained: In the final showdown, Larry and Amelia Earhart team up to stop Kahmunrah from using the tablet to open the underworld. They trick him and send him away for good. The tablet is secured, and all the exhibits are saved. Larry returns to New York, where the museum board finally agrees to let the exhibits come alive at night again. Amelia flies off into the sunrise, and Larry gets his happy ending with his friends.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves family adventures and silly comedy.
